name: ash the love demon!!
source:
Ashley Laurens is a 15 year old artist with a passion for stories and drawing, yet tends to be impulsive and shy with her work. when she stumbles upon a cat, her life changes forever! but is it for better or for worse? 

[From [url=https://loserlunaa.itch.io/ash-love-demon-official-game]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿什利·劳伦斯 (Ashley Laurens) 是一位15岁的艺术家，对故事和绘画充满热情，但对自己的作品却往往比较冲动和害羞。当她偶然发现一只猫时，她的生活永远改变了！但这是好还是坏呢？

[来自[url=https://loserlunaa.itch.io/ash-love-demon-official-game]itch.io[/url]]
